title: Certificate programs and Lean 4 formalization for "Rigidity of Fourier Multipliers for Universal Euler Convective Cancellations"
description:
This deposit contains the exact-arithmetic certificate programs and the Lean 4 formalization accompanying the paper Rigidity of Fourier Multipliers for Universal Euler Convective Cancellations.

The paper proves that a reality-compatible Fourier symbol on the three-torus satisfying the universal Euler convective cancellation must be the restriction of a constant-coefficient self-adjoint operator of order at most one, and that the solenoidal case reduces to the energy–helicity family. The proof combines analytic propagation over the lattice with finite rank certificates.

The programs certify the ranks of the finite seed matrices over the rationals, using integer and exact rational arithmetic and reductions modulo primes; no floating-point rank decision enters at any point. They also replay the propagation orderings in finite coordinate boxes, verify the singular-value formulas, and reproduce the certificate data reported in the paper. Two programs are independent at the algorithmic level and reconstruct the constraint matrices by recipient wavevector.

The Lean 4 development, built on Mathlib, covers the main classification theorem and its solenoidal corollary, together with the all-mode completion, the finite-dimensional content of the sharp certificate counts, and the local spectral and conditioning results. It contains no admitted proofs; the two finite seed rank certificates use native_decide.

All programs are run from a single entry point, which reports the interpreter version, source revision and working-tree state, and fails if any certificate is missing or any assertion fails. See the README for reproduction instructions.
